entities.summary: Micronesia (Federated States) is a sovereign nation in Micronesia, Oceania. Its capital is Palikir (Pohnpei state). Official languages include English. Government: Federal presidential republic in free association with the United States. Population: approximately 0.1 million. Area: 702 km². Comprehensive index for the Federated States of Micronesia covering Austronesian settlement (~2000 BCE), Nan Madol (megalithic city, Pohnpei, 'Venice of the Pacific'), Spanish colonisation (1886), German purchase (1899), Japanese mandate (1914-1945, Nanyo-cho), WWII (Chuuk/Truk Lagoon major Japanese naval base, air raids, Ghost Fleet), US Trust Territory (1947-1986), Compact of Free Association 1986, four-state federation (Yap, Chuuk, Pohnpei, Kosrae).

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: The Compact of Free Association (1986) established Micronesia as a federal presidential republic in free association with the United States, providing economic and security benefits to its population. This agreement has had a lasting impact on the region's political stability and economic development.
